_about: Which MORDHAU weapon stands for a Skyrim weapon: by the Skyrim weapon's kind (family, sheets/weapon_families.json) and words in its name (alternatives separated by |). For enemies and for the player. A design choice (lighter Skyrim materials -> lighter / plainer MORDHAU weapons), not from either game's data.

rows.note: play-test note, 2026-10-12. First of its family, so a scimitar of any material is one. MORDHAU's Scimitar is 115 cm long (tools/weapon_lengths.py). Its model could not be built before: its parts' names end in a number (SK_Scimitar_Blade_1), which both readers dropped; fixed the same day.

play-test note, 2026-10-12. Was the Bastard Sword (the user's choice of 2026-10-08): it is the only MORDHAU weapon given to a one-handed Skyrim family whose other grip is two-handed (bSecondIsTwoHanded, the greatsword's animations) - a Skyrim one-handed sword has no handle for the second hand. Now the Arming Sword: one-handed in both grips, 94 cm. The Bastard Sword stays as its own item, with MORDHAU's model.
